# zigler_precompiled v0.1.4 - Table of Contents

Download and use precompiled Zig NIFs safely with checksums

## Pages

- [Precompilation guide](https://zigler-precompiled.hexdocs.pm/precompilation_guide.md)
- [Changelog](https://zigler-precompiled.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [ZiglerPrecompiled](https://zigler-precompiled.hexdocs.pm/ZiglerPrecompiled.md): Download and use precompiled Zig NIFs safely with checksums.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix zigler_precompiled.build](https://zigler-precompiled.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.ZiglerPrecompiled.Build.md): Builds a single ZiglerPrecompiled NIF artifact for a target triple.
- [mix zigler_precompiled.download](https://zigler-precompiled.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.ZiglerPrecompiled.Download.md): Downloads precompiled NIF artifacts and generates a checksum file.
